summary.en: A truck bomb near a Colombian military base killed four civilians, among them a newborn, while a Venezuelan army strike on an ELN camp in Apure killed at least 19 combatants. President De la Espriella is expanding militarization along the Venezuelan border and cutting resources for the human-rights court, threatening its capacity to address abuses. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En lastebilbombe nær en colombiansk militærbase drepte fire sivile, blant dem et nyfødt barn, mens et venezuelansk hærangrep på en ELN-leir i Apure drepte minst 19 kampere. President De la Espriella utvider militariseringen langs den venezuelanske grensen og kutter ressurser til menneskerettighetsdomstolen, noe som truer dens evne til å håndtere overgrep. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
